svg.aria-label: NH3 three bond domains and one lone-pair domain
svg.title: Four ammonia domains, different nuclear inventory
svg.desc: Stage one names nitrogen and the supplied inventory. Stage two draws exactly three N-H directions and a fourth lone-pair direction. Stage three separates domain geometry from atom-only shape. A projection, not measured angles.

g.text: NH3: three N-H bonds; one N lone pair
Three bonded H nuclei: trigonal-pyramidal shape.
